title: AutoFirma parity from its source (clienteafirma
result: Facturae profile (`emisor` role, enveloped transform only, RSA key value, SHA-512 references); selectable digests (`signData` replaces `signPkcs1Sha256`); AGE policy for XAdES and CAdES; internally detached XAdES; ECDSA for AutoScript `NONE`; DocMDP P=1 guard in `firmar pdf`; PAdES digest and policy; the generic `signAutoScript` adapter.
evidence: commits 745579a, 3052b5a, f299ad6, 887ce38, 1539f3d, e908eeb, 63cb035; `pnpm check:ci` exit 0; xmlsec1 verifies XAdES SHA-1/256/512 and internally detached; `openssl cms -verify` passes CAdES SHA-512 under the AGE policy.
